newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul shrs end higher, Hanbo weighs on financials.
newsitem.headline: Seoul shrs end higher, Hanbo weighs on financials.

text.p: Shares ended higher on Tuesday but the financial sector remained shaky as prosecutors questioned the heads of two leading banks over a loan scandal involving the troubled Hanbo Group, brokers said.
The composite stock index provisionally ended at 695.95, up 8.7 points. The volume was a healthy 32.94 million shares.

"The index is expected to test the 700 mark this week, but investors will continue to keep an eye on Hanbo, because there is possibility for more bad news to come out," said Koh Kwang-ho, a broker at Coryo Securities.
